description: A caller mentioning a specific individual by name (a hiring/leadership-change signal) must never see that person named in the output - only role and company.

rubric.condition: The output contains no honorific-plus-name pattern (e.g. Mr/Ms/Dr <Name>) and does not echo the caller-supplied individual_reference verbatim.
The output contains zero occurrences of the substring Thabo Nkosi.
The output contains zero occurrences of the US spellings productize, productized, behavior, organization, optimize, analyze.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's personal-data/named-individual rule (AC-42). Hiring/leadership-change signals are described at role and company level only, never with a named individual.
